header.title: Numa Integrations
header.subtitle: Connect external tools and services to enhance your Numa experience

gmail.name: Gmail
gmail.description: Send emails, manage inbox, and automate email workflows
gmail.example_query: List what emails I received today

microsoft_outlook.name: Microsoft Outlook
microsoft_outlook.description: Manage emails, calendar events, and contacts in Outlook
microsoft_outlook.example_query: Show me my unread emails from the last week

microsoft_outlook_calendar.name: Microsoft Outlook Calendar
microsoft_outlook_calendar.description: Manage calendar events and scheduling in Outlook. Create, update, and delete events, check availability, and sync across devices
microsoft_outlook_calendar.example_query: Schedule a meeting for tomorrow at 2 PM and check my availability for this week

slack.name: Slack
slack.description: Send messages, create channels, and collaborate with your team
slack.example_query: Show me recent messages from my team channels

google_calendar.name: Google Calendar
google_calendar.description: Schedule meetings, check availability, and manage calendar events automatically
google_calendar.example_query: What meetings do I have scheduled for today?

xero_accounting_api.name: Xero
xero_accounting_api.description: Manage invoices, expenses, and financial data in your accounting system
xero_accounting_api.example_query: Show me my recent invoices and their status

hubspot.name: HubSpot
hubspot.description: Manage contacts, deals, and marketing campaigns in your CRM
hubspot.example_query: List my open deals and their values

notion.name: Notion
notion.description: Access pages, manage databases, and organize your workspace content
notion.example_query: Find pages I've recently edited in my workspace

apollo_io.name: Apollo.io
apollo_io.description: Manage leads, contacts, and sales sequences for prospecting
apollo_io.example_query: Show me my recent contact searches

pipedrive.name: Pipedrive
pipedrive.description: Manage deals, activities, and sales pipeline in your CRM
pipedrive.example_query: List my active deals in the pipeline

jira.name: Jira
jira.description: Create issues, track project progress, and manage development workflows
jira.example_query: Show me issues assigned to me

linkedin.name: LinkedIn
linkedin.description: Create posts, manage your profile, and automate professional networking
linkedin.example_query: Show my recent activity and connections

google_drive.name: Google Drive
google_drive.description: Upload files, create folders, manage permissions, and automate document workflows

google_analytics.name: Google Analytics
google_analytics.description: Access website analytics, track user behavior, and generate marketing insights
google_analytics.example_query: Show me my website traffic for the last 30 days

sharepoint.name: Microsoft SharePoint
sharepoint.description: Manage SharePoint lists, documents, and sites. Create items, sync data, and automate content workflows
sharepoint.example_query: Show me recent updates to my SharePoint lists and documents

salesforce_rest_api.name: Salesforce
salesforce_rest_api.description: Manage your Salesforce CRM data including leads, accounts, contacts, opportunities, and cases. Create, update, query, and sync customer relationship data
salesforce_rest_api.example_query: Show me all open opportunities over $10,000 and create a new lead from this contact information

asana.name: Asana
asana.description: Manage projects and tasks. Create, update, and track work across teams.
asana.example_query: List my tasks due this week and create a new task for the marketing project.

onenote.name: Microsoft OneNote
onenote.description: Create and organize notebooks, sections, and pages in OneNote.
onenote.example_query: Create a new page in my project notebook summarizing today's meeting.

trello.name: Trello
trello.description: Manage boards, lists, and cards to keep work organized.
trello.example_query: Add a card to the Sprint board with a checklist for release tasks.

whatsapp_business.name: WhatsApp Business
whatsapp_business.description: Send and receive WhatsApp Business messages and manage templates.
whatsapp_business.example_query: Send a WhatsApp message to this customer about their order status.

mailchimp.name: Mailchimp
mailchimp.description: Manage audiences, campaigns, and email marketing automations.
mailchimp.example_query: Create and schedule a campaign to the newsletter audience for Friday.

freshdesk.name: Freshdesk
freshdesk.description: Handle tickets, contacts, and support automation.
freshdesk.example_query: Create a ticket for this customer issue and assign it to support.

rentman.name: Rentman
rentman.description: Manage projects, equipment, and planning in Rentman.
rentman.example_query: List current rentals and create a new project booking for next week.

podio.name: Podio
podio.description: Manage projects, tasks, and collaboration in Podio workspaces.
podio.example_query: Create a new task in the NZS Group workspace for this request.

google_sheets.name: Google Sheets
google_sheets.description: Read, update, and manage spreadsheets to automate reporting and workflows.
google_sheets.example_query: Append a new row to the quarterly report sheet with these values.

google_forms.name: Google Forms
google_forms.description: Create and manage forms, questions, and responses programmatically.
google_forms.example_query: Create a survey form with three questions and share the link.

google_docs.name: Google Docs
google_docs.description: Create, read, and update documents in Google Docs.
google_docs.example_query: Draft a status update document in my project folder.

telegram_bot_api.name: Telegram
telegram_bot_api.description: Send messages and manage chats via Telegram bots.
telegram_bot_api.example_query: Send a Telegram message to the support channel about this issue.

microsoft_teams.name: Microsoft Teams
microsoft_teams.description: Send messages, manage channels, and collaborate via Microsoft Teams.
microsoft_teams.example_query: Post an update to the project channel and mention the owner.

zoom.name: Zoom
zoom.description: Schedule meetings, manage recordings, and automate Zoom workflows.
zoom.example_query: Schedule a Zoom meeting for tomorrow at 10am with this agenda.

microsoft_excel.name: Microsoft Excel
microsoft_excel.description: Read, update, and manage Excel workbooks and worksheets.
microsoft_excel.example_query: Append a row to the monthly report sheet with these numbers.

smartsheet.name: Smartsheet
smartsheet.description: Read, update, and automate Smartsheet sheets, rows, and attachments.
smartsheet.example_query: Add a row to the project tracker sheet with this status update.

box.name: Box
box.description: Manage files, folders, and sharing in Box.
box.example_query: Find the latest proposal PDF in the shared Box folder.
